notes.en: Aimed for a Renaissance burin study built on generous golden eight-head silhouettes and three tapered aged-ink line tiers so fine facial portraiture, unified paddle-shaped hands, and abdominal relief dissolve cleanly into an unmistakable four-limb glyph at the 38px navbar size. What remains weak: the foreshortened standing feet are still relatively schematic next to the three-quarter spread feet on the circle, and tucking the raised hands just beneath the top edge of the square for small-size legibility slightly softens strict top-line fingertip contact.
